description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectUsersButton, a specialized widget component for rendering a user selection button within a subpanel UI in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework. The class extends a base button class and provides methods for display logic, including access control and popup request generation.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectUsersButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a user selection button in a subpanel, with configurable properties and access controls.
